offers_products.reason: Food and drink are incidental to the gaming and hospitality experience; no products sold as main offering.

offers_services.reason: Operates casino gaming, hotels, restaurants and taverns, providing entertainment and hospitality services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Casino resorts and neighborhood taverns serve individual gamblers, diners and hotel guests.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to individual patrons; no significant business or government buyers are evident from casinos and taverns.

recurring_revenue.reason: Locals-focused taverns and casinos rely on repeat patrons using the True Rewards loyalty program.

cyclical_demand.reason: Gambling, dining out and hotel stays are discretionary; customers cut back in recessions.

big_ticket.reason: Customers make small, frequent purchases: gaming play, meals, drinks and hotel stays at casinos and taverns.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for gaming machines, tables, hotel rooms and venues, which are asset-based rather than staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are individual casino and tavern patrons, mostly Nevada locals and visitors.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns and maintains seven casino resorts including The STRAT, plus 74 taverns; needs ongoing property and slot investment.

notes: Recurring revenue is a judgement call: locals tavern play repeats, but casino and hotel visits are discretionary.
